name: Inherent Magics
body:
From deep within your newly forged soul, you summon forth some of the magic that use to lay within you when you were a magical weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, Character level 5th

Benefit(s): You may give your weapon form a number of magic weapon special abilities equal to 1/4th your character level. You may change which abilities you have via a special ritual that takes eight hours to complete.
